content.short: CryptoLock provides crypto security, fraud prevention, and asset recovery services.
content.description: CryptoLock centers on crypto security, fraud prevention, and asset recovery to support safer use of cryptocurrencies. The project aims to promote broad adoption of digital assets by delivering transparent and secure solutions. In its early phase, it seeks to make post-breach services accessible to startups and individuals who may not have the funds to afford them, with the goal of democratizing the industry and creating a more inclusive ecosystem.
